definitions.explanation: A flooded field used for growing rice. One of the most iconic elements of the Japanese rural landscape.

examples.english: To flood the rice field with water.
When spring comes, we plant rice in the paddy.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{田|た}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Rice fields stretch out across this region.

notes:
READING VARIANTS:
- {田|た}: The standalone noun form
- ⟦{田|た}んぼ→田んぼ：00402_tanbo⟧: Common informal variant meaning 'rice paddy'

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{水田|すいでん}→水田：13262_suiden⟧ (wet rice field)
- ⟦{田畑|たはた}→田畑：13527_tahata⟧ (fields, rice paddies and dry fields)
- ⟦{田植|たう}え→田植え：22734_taue⟧ (rice planting)

CULTURAL NOTE: Rice paddies ({田|た}) are central to Japanese agriculture and culture. The character {田|た} appears in many family names (⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧, ⟦{山田|やまだ}→山田：09529_yamada⟧, {池田|いけだ}) and place names.
